$comment: Second TRUSTED issuer keypair for the cross-issuer-key fixture. A distinct authority that the verifier trusts, but which is NOT the issuer of (nor a cosigner in the issuerChain of) the credential under test. Used to prove a verifier binds each signature to a key controlled by the credential's issuer, so one trusted issuer cannot impersonate another. TEST-ONLY keypair; the seed is a SHA-256 of a fixed label, never use it in production.

provenance.ref: deterministic, reproducible test-only keypair (not an RFC vector)
provenance.purpose: trusted-but-unrelated issuer for the key-issuer-binding case
